## Purpose and scope

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-fund`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run build:single`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] Remote `quality` and `dependencies` CI checks pass
- [ ] Focused regression test added, or a reason no new test is needed is recorded
- [ ] Browser/accessibility/deployment checks recorded where relevant
- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the linked issue are satisfied

## AI and review

- [ ] AI assistance, if any, is disclosed and its output was independently checked
- [ ] Existing issues and open PRs were checked for overlap
- [ ] Security, privacy, data, architecture, or production-sensitive changes are flagged
- [ ] No secrets, production mutations, access changes, or unapproved spending
- [ ] Human review is requested; agents must not self-merge

## Risk, rollback, and release

Describe data/privacy/security impact, exact revert path, and any deployment or
outcome verification that remains after merge. Implementation Done, production
release, and verified customer outcome are distinct states.
